system_requirements.Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4460, 2.70GHz or AMD FX™-6300 or better
system_requirements.Additional Notes: Dreamcore requires a GPU with Ray-Tracing support, as it is essential for the game’s lighting system. If your graphics card does not support Ray-Tracing, some areas may render incorrectly, appear completely black, or exhibit severe visual artifacts. You may still attempt to play the game, but please be aware that the experience may be significantly impacted.
